thread:
mira: Quick async check-in — audits / remediation status 
- What I did: finished GCP KMS key inventory, found 2 keys with last rotation >400 days; opened ticket SEC-421 to rotate.
- Blocker: need owner approval from @dan to schedule rotation window for prod-kms (no maintenance window this week).
- Today: run partial vuln scan on dedicated infra, and push CR to infra repo for least-priv IAM role changes.
Any objections to rotating those keys Thu 2-4pm PST? :calendar:

dan: Saw the ticket, thanks. I’m OOO Wed morning but Thu 2-4pm looks fine from the app side. Need @alex to confirm backup snapshot completes before 2pm. pinging alex.

alex: I can move the nightly snapshot earlier to 12:30pm and bump retention TTL. Will open a small PR to change the cron. @mira — please add the backup step to the SEC-421 playbook so ops run it manually if needed.

sam: FYI vuln scanner flagged libxml2 outdated on 3 non-prod nodes (low-med). I’ll remediate in canary tomorrow then schedule prod patching if stable. Leaving notes in SEC-419. cc @mira

sec-bot: Reminder: compliance checklist 'SOC2-keys' is due in 5 days. Run `/sec checklist run SOC2-keys` to generate the current report and attach to the ticket.

mira: Thanks — added backup/playbook snippet to SEC-421 and included rollback steps. Assigned @jordan to run the post-rotation audit and verify access logs. Also left a CR link for Alex review: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/543 :eyes:

alex: Reviewing the PR now. Small nit on cron formatting, will push a fix and run integration test. Should approve after tests pass. :thumbsup:

jordan: I’ll take post-rotation audit. Plan: run key-access logs query after rotation: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Encrypt\"" --limit 1000` and check for any unexpected principals. Will post results in SEC-421 thread once done.

mira: Great — thanks all. No further blockers from my side. If rotation slips, we can fallback to rotating the non-prod duplicates first and schedule prod next week.

(Last comment: misc follow-ups happening in SEC-421 ticket thread.)
